meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能帮你把聊天渠道(如 Slack、Telegram、WhatsApp 等)接到智能体小组:查看当前接线、新接入渠道、加同平台群组,还能把渠道移到别组并选隔离方式。
howto.when: 当你在首次配置渠道、新增渠道后,或想重新调整接线时触发;若实例还没有 owner,会先提示运行 /init-first-agent。

say.text: 帮我把这个 Slack 频道接到现有智能体小组,用共享会话。
say.note: 会按共享会话接入,先问平台 ID。

say.text: 把 WhatsApp 在智能体小组 A 的接线移到小组 B,旧会话保留在 A。
say.note: 执行后新消息进 B 组,旧会话不迁移。

say.text: 给 Telegram 再加一个群,给这个群新建独立智能体小组。
say.note: 走配对流程,等你在群里发配对码。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can wire chat channels (Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, etc.) to agent groups: inspect current wiring, add channels or channel groups, move a channel between groups, choose isolation modes, and show a config summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered during initial setup, after adding a channel, or whenever you want to reconfigure wiring. If the instance has no owner yet, it first prompts to run /init-first-agent.

say_en.text: Wire this Slack channel to the existing agent group with a shared session.
say_en.note: Wires it as a shared session; asks for the platform ID.

say_en.text: Move this WhatsApp group's wiring from agent A to agent B, keeping old sessions in A.
say_en.note: New messages go to B; existing sessions stay with A.

say_en.text: Add another Telegram group and create a separate agent group for it.
say_en.note: Runs the pairing flow; you post the code in the new group.
